name: Twist of Fate
description: Ada is a young girl who believes that if she is abandoned by her first love, she will be unhappy forever like the women of her maternal side. While trying to escape the fate of her family, Ada falls in love with Rüzgar, a student from Albania at the same university who is threatened with deportation. Believing that Rüzgar is her first love, Ada proposes him and they have a fake marriage to prevent his deportation. She believes that Rüzgar will literally propose to her on the 3rd anniversary of their fake marriage and then their real marriage adventure will finally begin. But unfortunately, all the dreams and hopes of Ada will be ruined when she is abandoned by Rüzgar on their 3rd wedding anniversary. Ada immediately takes action to get her first love back. But fate has its own way and will put Bora in Ada's way at an unexpected moment... A workaholic, callous, self-righteous alpha male with tightly closed doors for love...

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Believing that she will lose her eternal happiness if she cannot meet with her first love, Ada falls in love with Rüzgar, who confronts her at university and needs Turkish citizenship in order not to go back to his country, and proposes to her. The only purpose of this marriage for Rüzgar is to get citizenship, and for Ada, marrying her first love is to beat her luck. On this happiest day for Rüzgar to receive citizenship, Ada got into an argument with the founder and editor-in-chief of the popular social content platform Bizdeböyle.net, who came to the cafe where she worked. This argument resulted in her being fired. When Ada goes to the company where she works to see Rüzgar, her whole world falls apart when she sees him and her colleague Tuğçe... In order for Ada to win Rüzgar back, she has to get a job at Bora's company and for this, she has to make herself accepted by Bora, a man she hates who is very difficult to please unless you know him better. Will Ada be able to do this?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Before Ada delivers the entire video to Bora, she makes a deal to ensure she stays at the company, but being Bora's assistant is much more difficult than Ada thought. Ada, who has become the number one gossip topic at the company, gets the nickname "27" because she is Bora's 27th assistant. While the employees bet on how permanent it will be, Ada tries to stay on good terms with Bora. As she starts researching to get to know her rival Tuğçe better, Rüzgar, who keeps his marriage a secret, sees Ada as a threat to the company and tries to drive her away. After the video scandal, Bora gets an opportunity to tidy things up. Learning that the other party will come to the extremely critical business dinner with his wife, Bora decides to go to the dinner with Tuğçe. On the other hand, Ada sets up a game for Tuğçe so that Bora can go to dinner with her and she succeeds. The meal, which started out perfectly, turns into a nightmare when Tuğçe and Rüzgar come to the restaurant.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Tuğçe asks Ada to inform her of Bora's daily plans, to act as a kind of spy. Realizing that Tuğçe likes Bora, Ada accepts this offer. Thus, Bora and Tuğçe will be together, and Rüzgar will return to her. Ada takes things one step further and starts mentoring Tuğçe about Bora. She enters the chat program that Bora uses for writing articles and tells her to chat with Bora without giving her name. Realizing that Tuğçe is not very good at correspondence, Ada writes to Bora herself. Impressed by the conversation of the mysterious woman in front of her, Bora thinks that he has found good material for his new series of articles and invites the correspondent to dinner, and Tuğçe gets very excited. Thanks to Ada's correspondence, Tuğçe begins to believe that Bora is in love with her and offers to go to the mountain house on the pretext of a photo shoot to stay alone with Bora. Bora also invites Ada to her chalet. And when Rüzgar follows them in order to be close to Tuğçe, things will get messy.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Ada is very disappointed when Rüzgar proposes to Tuğçe, and she decides to focus on her career and win the favor of Bora. On the other hand, Ali expresses his doubts that Bora is interested in Ada. Bora, who firmly rejects Ali's suspicions, acts contrary to Ada in order to distance himself from her and asks her to stay away from his personal affairs. Ada cannot understand this strict attitude of Bora and hangs on to her work with all her might. Worried that Bora will fire her, she asks Tuğçe for help. Bora, on the other hand, makes a surprise meeting with his ex-girlfriend Fulya. Ada and Tuğçe follow Bora to the meeting place. An unexpected tension arises between Ada and Fulya at the restaurant. As Bora tries to escape, he constantly finds Ada in front of him, while Elif's fondness for Ada will cause Ada to go to Bora's house more often.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: While Bora is looking for topics for new content, Ada comes up with the idea of a 'white marriage'. Bora likes Ada's idea very much and asks both Tuğçe and Ada to prepare a series of articles. Tuğçe warns Ada not to write the text, but Ada challenges her. Meanwhile, Tuğçe goes to the immigration office to research for the articles. There, she meets a person who knows Ada and Rüzgar closely. Ada and Rüzgar are forced to cooperate in the face of the danger of their secret being exposed. Ada works tirelessly to make good use of this opportunity to showcase her writing skills. When Tuğçe realizes that Ada will not give up writing, she puts her plans into action. Thus, the rivalry between Ada and Tuğçe transcends into hostility. On the day they will deliver the texts to Bora, Ada confronts Tuğçe's dark side.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Bora, seeing Rüzgar in Ada's House, leaves without waiting for an explanation. Ada goes after Bora and tries to explain the situation, but clearing Bora's suspicions will not be easy for Ada. Trying to find out the source of the 'white marriage' article, Celal wants to visit the company and meet with Tuğçe. Celal meets Bora when he cannot find Tuğçe. What Celal, who has increased his visits to the company, does not know is that Ada and Rüzgar work there. The Bizdeboyle.net team decides to go to a relationship camp to research for a new article. Bora, Ada, Tuğçe, and Rüzgar join the relationship camp for two days to observe. Little jealousy arises between Bora and Ada, who go to the camp as a couple. Feeling remorseful for not being honest with Bora, Ada decides to tell the truth. Will Ada gather her courage and confess her past with Rüzgar to Bora?

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Celal's arrival at the company makes things quite complicated for Ada. Ada is tired of trying not to reveal the facts and is on the verge of a difficult decision. Feeling guilty for the lies she's told Bora, Ada decides to quit her job. Bora is shaken by Ada's sudden decision and begins to question the reason behind her giving up her dreams in a snap. As Ada begins her search for work, Bora, who has lost trust in Ada, orders her to be cut off from the company. Is Ada, who is faced with a difficult test between her dreams and her reality, going to tell Bora the real reason for quitting? On the other hand, Celal visits Ada's house to observe the marriage of Ada and Rüzgar. Ada and Rüzgar have to do what Celal wants to handle the situation.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Ada explains the lie she told Bora. Unable to accept such a lie, Bora says he doesn't want to see Ada again. Ada, with the weight of the words she heard from Bora, wants to re-enter the company and prove herself to Bora, so she talks to Rüzgar to help her with returning to the company. Since Rüzgar has no other choice but to help Ada, he takes his chance with Tuğçe. With what excuse will Rüzgar ask Tuğçe to get Ada back to work. Ada returns to the company with a mission that surprises everyone. Disturbed by the disregard for his authority, Bora intends to force Ada out. He gives an impossible task to her and Tuğçe. If they don't interview the famous pop icon Kuzey Batı, they'll both be out of work. While Ada is trying to fulfill the given task,  she also is caught up with looking for the ring with her name and Rüzgar's. Ada and Tuğçe put their plans to interview Kuzey Batı into action. Bora cannot hide his discomfort about Kuzey's proximity to Ada.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: News begins to circulate at the company that Bora will get a new assistant for the job. Not wanting to lose her place, Ada joins forces with Tuğçe to eliminate the assistant candidates, but a surprise candidate who suddenly appears disrupts all their plans. Bora's childhood friend, Meltem, begins work as an assistant. As Meltem and Bora's sincerity infuriates Ada, Ada, realizing Meltem's suspicious behavior, opens the situation to Tuğçe and asks for help. Ada and Tuğçe follow Meltem to try to spot one of her shortcomings. Ada warns Bora about Meltem, but Bora thinks Ada is jealous. But Ada rolls up her sleeves and reveals Meltem's true face to Bora.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Ada goes crazy when she sees Meltem in a bathrobe at Bora's house. A relentless race begins between Ada and Meltem, who cannot even admit to herself that she is jealous of Bora. Bora is caught in the middle of the war between the two women. Ada includes Tuğçe in her plan to intimidate Meltem. Ada's plan works and the duo finds a way to keep Meltem away from the company. Ada and Tuğçe's efforts do not go unnoticed by Rüzgar. Rüzgar starts to question the reason for Tuğçe's anger towards Meltem. Ada finds Bora next to her while tracking down Meltem. Bora takes action to clear Ada's doubts about Meltem. Ada finds evidence that will reveal Meltem's deception and shares the evidence with Bora. While she thinks she has finally succeeded in convincing Bora, she is unaware that things will get even more complicated.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Tuğçe's careless attitude bothers Rüzgar and he decides to leave Tuğçe and return to Ada. Unsatisfied with this situation, Ada seeks a remedy to keep Rüzgar away from her. Finally, she makes an interesting plan to bring Bora with her and reunite Tuğçe and Rüzgar. With Ada's organization, Bora, Rüzgar and Tuğçe find themselves in the boxing gym. Ada, whose plan backfires, makes a new plan to reconcile Rüzgar and Tuğçe. Ada will invite Rüzgar to her home to ensure that him and Tuğçe will be left alone. Bora, who wants to make Ada forgive him, helps her and the duo, who spend time together become even closer. Rüzgar traps Tuğçe with a trump card in order to head the graphics department of the company. Thereupon, Ada and Tuğçe begin to look for ways to fulfill Rüzgar's request.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Bora and Ada, who find out that Selin has kidnapped Ali, go after the duo. They find themselves in a game while trying to stop Ali and Selin. At this time, an interesting rumor spreads about Bora and Ada in the company. Unable to reach them, Rüzgar and Tuğçe begin to search for Bora and Ada. Ali and Selin's plan works. Finally, the true feelings of Ada and Bora are revealed as Bora declares his love for Ada. The lovers decide to hide their relationship, but it won't be as easy as they think.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Bora is not satisfied with the reason Ada gave for their separation and tries to learn the truth of the matter. Because Ada cannot tell the truth, she claims the bad luck of the women in her family. Thus, she wants to distance herself from Bora, but Bora neither believes in this superstition nor does he want to give up on Ada. While trying to break Ada's superstition, Bora announces their relationship in the middle of the company. Ada and Bora's relationship creates a bombshell effect both in the company and at home. Pressed by Tuğçe and her aunt Nergis, Ada resorts to various ways to resist her feelings and convince Bora. However, the 'Baht Oyunu' will create unexpected results.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Ada is confused about what to do in the face of an intruder who appears at the door at a romantic moment. While Bora questions the reason for Celal's visit, it becomes difficult for Ada to hide the truth. Not wanting to keep their relationship secret, Bora tries to talk to Ada's family. While Nergis is doing her best to prevent this relationship, Rüzgar and Tuğçe's plans to separate Ada and Bora come into play. Realizing that Ada will not leave Bora, Nergis invites Rüzgar for dinner and tries to put Rüzgar in Ada's mind. Will the love of the couple, who go through a difficult test, be able to stand against all these obstacles?

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Attorney Turgut takes over Ada's divorce case. Bora, who is after Ada's first love, thinks Turgut is Ada's first love when he sees Ada with Turgut. Bora brings Nergis and Aslan together with Turgut and tells that Ada has found her first love. When Ada, Tuğçe and Rüzgar come to the restaurant where they meet, there is a complete uproar. Despite all the interference, Bora decides to propose to Ada. Tuğçe, who knocked on Ada's door before Bora, tells Ada that she has uncovered the secret she's been keeping with Rüzgar. Shocked by Tuğce's learning the truth, Ada is surprised by what Bora will do when she sees him coming to her door with his family, and with flowers in his hand.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Bora and his family's attempt to ask for Ada's hand ends in disappointment. Realizing that she cannot work with Bora any longer, Ada decides to quit her job. Ada goes to Bora's room to say goodbye, but Ada encounters an obstacle just before she leaves the job. This obstacle, which can change her fortune, causes a new rivalry between her and Tuğçe. Bora gives Ada and Tuğçe the task of preparing a new article, saying that they are nominated for an award ceremony organized by a foundation. Thus, Ada begins to work with all her might to prove herself. Pursuing her new writing, Ada suddenly disappears. While everyone is frantically searching for Ada, Ada is in big trouble.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: In the final episode, Ada is fired from the company by Bora after Tuğçe reveals her secret. Determined not to leave her job or Bora to Tuğçe, Ada finds the solution by asking Zafer for help. Thanks to Zafer, Ada's new position in the company surprises everyone. Bora, whose anger towards Ada does not subside, decides to send Tuğçe to the award ceremony. Watching Tuğçe and Bora's rapprochement, Ada is determined to stand firm against Bora despite the pain she has experienced. On the other hand, the cold war between Rüzgar and Ada ends and an agreement is reached near their divorce. Overwhelmed by the weight of her lies, Ada makes a big decision. The decision she takes will change not only her own life, but also Bora's life and relationships forever.
